jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

As an Accountant Intern, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of our finance department while gaining valuable hands-on experience.
 
 

• Process purchase invoices: From reception to handling and encoding, you will ensure every detail is captured accurately. 

• Encode bank transactions: Play a key role in keeping our financial systems running smoothly. 

• Clear supplier accounts: Help maintain strong relationships by ensuring accounts are up-to-date and precise. 

• Assisting with VAT declarations: Gain valuable insight into compliance and tax processes. 

• Supporting general ledger entries and balance sheet accounts: Contribute to the foundation of our financial reporting with hands-on experience. 
 

• Your are not a student anymore (
this is a requirement) 

• You are looking for a short-term first experience. 

• You are available for at least 6 months (start October/November 2026) 

• You are fluent in French or Dutch and have a working knowledge of English. 

• You have basic knowledge of Excel and a desire to enhance your technical skills. 

• You want to use your skills to participate to our mission and you adhere to WWF’s values: Courage, Integrity, Respect and Collaboration.

Your Role? 
 
 

• Process and verify purchase invoices and expense reports with a high level of accuracy. 

• Prepare supplier payments and follow up on outstanding balances. 

• Process bank statements and monitor cash reporting. 

• Support the preparation of VAT and intra-community (IC) declarations. 

• Assist in the reconciliation of balance sheet accounts. 

• Contribute to month-end and year-end closing activities. 

• Support audit preparation and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. 

• Ensure financial data is processed accurately, timely, and consistently. 

• Support Corporate Income Tax (CIT) preparation. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and process improvement initiatives.  

 
 

Your Profile: 
 
 

• You have initial experience in General accounting 

• Experience with SAP is required. 

• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You combine strong analytical skills with a hands-on mindset. 

• You are accurate, detail-oriented, and well organized. 

• You are proactive and willing to take initiative. 

• You think critically, challenge constructively, and propose solutions. 

• You are eager to learn and comfortable exploring new tools and systems independently. 

• You can manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• You are a team player with strong communication skills.

Company Description

Our client is an international company operating in the real estate sector, located in the heart of Brussels. With a multicultural environment and several entities to manage, the company operates within an international structure and works closely with its parent company abroad. The finance team deals with multiple accounting standards and international reporting requirements.

Your Role

Working directly alongside the Chief Accountant, you will be responsible for the accounting of several entities and contribute to the preparation of financial information for both local and international reporting purposes. You will work with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, while also contributing to IFRS reporting.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage the general accounting of several entities.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, depending on the entity.
• Participate in monthly and annual closing procedures.
• Prepare the necessary adjustments for IFRS reporting.
• Perform account reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data.
• Contribute to reporting activities for the parent company.
• Work closely with the Chief Accountant and support the continuous improvement of accounting processes and internal controls.
• Collaborate with international finance teams to ensure consistent and reliable financial information.

Your Profile

• You have a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have solid experience in general accounting.
• You are familiar with Belgian GAAP and are willing to develop your knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and accounting software.
• You are rigorous, analytical and detail-oriented.
• A good command of English is an asset in this international environment.

Soft skills

Your role…
  
As a Cost Calculator you are responsible for developing and calculating accurate and competitive cost price calculations of our industrial vehicles and trailers. You collaborate closely with different stakeholders within our organisation; Engineering, Commercial, Purchasing, Production, in order to translate our customers' requests into an accurate budget estimate. After production of the vehicles you carry out a post-calculation in which you analyse the realised costs and margins. You investigate deviations and actively contribute to improve future cost price calculations.
  
 
  
Your responsibilities…
    
• You analyse customer requests, technical specifications and quotations in order to prepare budget estimates for the production of our industrial vehicles.  
• You will make cost price calculations and price analyses in Excel and our internal software system.  
• You take into account the required materials, components, working hours, etc and translate them into an accurate budget estimate.  
• You will work closely with the Engineering department to correctly interpret technical designs and product / material information.  
• Via our Purchasing team you request prices from our suppliers to support your calculations.  
• You perform post-production calculations and compare the actual costs with the pre-estimate so you can detect deviations and/or formulate optimizations and propose improvements for future calculations. 

Your profile…
    
• You have a Bachelor or Master in Engineering or a technical equivalent. Candidates with a financial or analytical background and strong affinity with technology and production are also welcome to apply.   
• Experience in a similar role is a plus but not a must.  Both junior and senior profiles are welcome.   
• You have a particular interest in numbers, a technical production environment, transportation.  
• You are detail oriented and work accurately.  
• You have numeric insight and possess strong analytical thinking.  
• You have a cost-focused mindset.  
• You are proficient in MS Excel and can work well with other MS Office SW.  
• You have excellent communication skills.  
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.description:
Your responsibilities

• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.

• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

Our client is an international organization active in the energy sector.

• Power BI: Experience with Power BI is a plus and will be positively valued.
Analytical mindset: Ability to understand and challenge complex cost flows, allocation keys and reporting logic, with strong attention to detail and data consistency.

• Ways of working: Structured, accurate, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance and operational functions.
• Industry background: Experience in a company with manufacturing or production operations is a strong advantage, particularly in an industrial, energy, chemical or petrochemical environment.
• Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Dutch or Italian would be an asset.

jobs.description:
• Safely operating reach trucks to maneuver, stack, retrieve, and store palletized goods in high-bay warehouse racks.  
•   
Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.
    
•   
Performing visual quality inspections on incoming goods, reporting discrepancies or damage promptly to the warehouse supervisor.
    
•   
Replenishing pick faces and staging inventory for order pickers to prevent bottlenecks.
